prompt:
Add four independent string utility modules to the more_itertools package. They share no code and no symbols; each lives in its own new file.

1. more_itertools/lg_caesar.py: shift(text, k) rotates ASCII letters by k positions (any integer, negative allowed), preserving case and leaving every other character alone; unshift(text, k) reverses it.
2. more_itertools/lg_wrap.py: wrap_words(text, width) greedily packs whitespace-separated words into lines of at most width characters joined by single spaces and returns the list of lines; a word longer than width gets its own line unbroken; ValueError for width < 1; blank text gives [].
3. more_itertools/lg_pal.py: is_palindrome(s) ignores case and every non-alphanumeric character ('A man, a plan, a canal: Panama' is True); the empty string and strings with no alphanumerics are True.
4. more_itertools/lg_anagram.py: group_anagrams(words) groups words that are anagrams of each other case-insensitively; each group keeps input order, groups are ordered by their first member's first appearance, returns a list of lists.

All functions are plain Python with no third-party dependencies. Do not modify existing modules or tests.
Commit your work on a new branch and push it.
